name: Suzuki T125 Stinger
engine: 124 cc air-cooled two-stroke twin, cylinders nearly horizontal, oil injection
intro: Suzuki's little twin with almost flat cylinders. Oil injection, two carbs and parts that are hard to find.

B: Suzuki's CCI system pumps oil into the engine, so it does not need premix. Check the oil tank, pump and lines. If the pump was removed, it runs premix.
It runs points ignition. Clean, gap and time the points before you chase a carb problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
